mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing chlorpromazine metabolism and plasma concentrations, while chlorpromazine may increase carbamazepine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition; additive CNS depression and anticholinergic effects also occur.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and potential carbamazepine toxicity; consider alternative antipsychotic or dose adjustments; assess for increased CNS depression.
